name: XProblemCreditMgr
caption: Əlavə modullar / Kreditlər / Problemli kreditlərin idarə olunması

datasets.name: IntCache
datasets.sql:
select p.id,p.numberofcredit,VAL_NAME,b.name,REST,DUEREST, INTERESTREST,creditlineamount,dateofconclusion,duedatefirstcontract,
 case when nvl(fl.status ,0)=1then
0 else q.id end as
 TRPROCESSED,(select count(*) from cm_folderplace_info where creditid=p.id) qeydsayi,cr.description crtype,
b.phonenumber,gr.anyinfotodisting,gr.pledgeprice,(select name from cm_mehkeme s where s.id=fl.mehid)meh,fl.mehid,
DUEINTERESTREST,REST+DUEREST+INTERESTREST+DUEINTERESTREST fullrest, 
dueday,q.id qovid,q.name qovluq,f.name filial,nvl(fl.status ,0)status,p.currency,p.BRANCHID,p.credittype from 
cm_active_credits p,cm_credittypes cr,
cm_curr_state h,cm_guarantee gr,
cm_boorowerinfo b,
cm_qovluq q,
filial_t f,
avalute_t v,
(select * from  cm_folderplace s where  senddate= (select max(senddate) from cm_folderplace where creditid=s.creditid)) fl
 
where p.id=h.creditid and
p.id=b.creditid and
p.qovid=q.id and
p.id=gr.creditid(+)  and h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest+h.interestrest>0 and
p.BRANCHID=f.id and
(p.id=fl.creditid(+)) and
--fl.status=1 and 
-- (fl.senddate= (select max(senddate) from cm_folderplace where creditid=p.id))) and 
p.currency=v.valute  and p.credittype=cr.id --and p.id=43112
